Policy

Privacy Policy

This page explains what information Binary Baker collects, how it is used, and how to request updates to your data.

Quick Summary

  • Our privacy policy explains what information we collect and why.
  • It also covers data protection practices and how to contact us about your data.

Policy Scope

Clear and practical data handling guidance.

Our policy is written for readability while preserving legal clarity for enquiries and project communications.

  • Contact form data
  • Use limitations
  • Access and correction rights

Policy Details

How privacy is managed at Binary Baker

Information We Collect

We collect information submitted through contact and quote forms, including names, email addresses, phone numbers, and project details required to respond.

How Information Is Used

Submitted data is used to respond to enquiries, prepare project scopes, and provide delivery communication. We do not sell personal information.

Storage and Security

We use access controls and operational safeguards to protect submitted information and reduce unauthorized access risk.

Your Rights

You may request updates, corrections, or deletion of personal information previously provided through this website.

Privacy Contact

Requests and updates

For privacy-related requests, email bradley@binarybaker.co.za with enough detail for verification and response.
